decisions.reason: As the flagship focus with low keeping costs and strategic importance, the option remains valuable and uncertainty still supports keeping it open.
A core LED luminaire line with low incremental costs and established market fit, so there is little reason to abandon the option.
The home automation server box has not shown sufficient evidence of value and likely carries higher support costs, making its option value no longer worth keeping.
A luminaire family close to the established offer with low uncertainty and low keeping costs, so the option should be maintained.
